messages:
elaine: Prototype drop — compact conversation controls for the playground (screenshot attached). Quick UX + a11y + copy check? Main questions: 1) where to put stop / regenerate (inline vs overflow toolbar), 2) token counter visibility + screen-reader labeling, 3) prompt library quick-insert affordance. Want short recs, aiming to ship small tweaks Fri. aj: Inline controls keep focus. prefer inline for regenerate. Ensure hit targets >= 44px. If inline, add a persistent overflow for 'advanced' actions. devon: Inline works but a11y concerns: use `aria-live` for streaming text. token counter should be visually shown but also have a sr-only label like 'Tokens used: 120' rather than relying on icon alone. hari: UX copy nit — avoid 'tokens' for general users. Maybe use 'Message length' or 'Usage' in hover copy. e.g., 'Message length: 120 tokens'. maria: Copy tweak: 'Stop' reads abrupt. Suggest 'Pause' while streaming, and use 'Regenerate response' or 'Try again' for the second action. ben: Semantics: pause vs stop are different. Pause should keep the connection and allow resume; stop cancels. We might need both. My vote: surface 'Pause' inline (togglable) and keep 'Cancel' in overflow. elaine: Good point — we'll surface Pause inline as a toggle and move Cancel to overflow. For sr-only suggestions, propose something like `Streaming paused` and set `aria-pressed` for the toggle. devon: Example snippet for aria and live region:```html
...streaming text...
Tokens used: 120 ``` cory: Layout: inline controls push down the author line at small widths. Consider an overlay anchored to the message right rail instead of inline so we avoid layout shifts. Prompt library quick-insert pill also looks cramped when collapsed. elaine: Overlay tradeoffs noted — less layout shift vs discoverability. Any telemetry on stop/regenerate frequency? aj: Telemetry: stop ~2% sessions, regenerate ~18%. Prioritize regenerate discoverability. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: design-ux/proto-compact-controls deployed to staging at 1766544000 :rocket: devon: Accessibility nit: keyboard order must be preserved. Tab sequence should hit controls, but after that the input should be next. Also ensure Enter on Regenerate triggers expected focus. elaine: Action items: 1) update copy to 'Pause' / 'Regenerate response' per suggestions, 2) add sr-only token label and aria-live region, 3) keep regenerate visible, move pause/cancel to overflow with clear aria-labels, 4) create short a11y test plan for keyboard/sr. I'll open a PR today and file the follow-up ticket. tagging @aj @cory for follow-ups. aj: :thumbsup: I'll add hit target calcs and spacing metrics. cory: I'll mock the overlay option and a compact prompt-insert state by EOD. elaine: Thanks all. Filing ticket PROJ-3214 with screenshots and proposed copy. Quick check during design review tomorrow morning.
